subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice cutoff, PO header mapping, and early-pay request
messages:
From: Sofia Reyes <s.reyes@heliontech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: HelionTech Procurement <procure@heliontech.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding form + invoice cutoff / early pay inquiry

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the welcome — excited to get HelionTech set up as a Redwood supplier. We filled out the vendor onboarding form and attached it here (Helion_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf). A couple quick questions from our finance team as we prepare the first PO: 

- Invoice cutoff: Does Redwood treat an invoice as "received" based on invoice date or delivery date when a PO is present? Our typical AP practice wants to know if invoices submitted by 5pm PT on the 15th are included in that cycle.
- PO header mapping: We want to ensure our invoices route correctly. Do you require a specific PO header (PO#, ship-to, remit-to, GL code) to avoid routing delays? We can include multiple reference fields if needed.
- Net terms & early pay: Our standard offer is Net60, but we can provide a 2% discount for Net15 early-pay. We'd like to propose an early-pay pilot for the first two months (3 invoices) to accelerate cash flow. Is Redwood open to executing early-pay under a vendor discount program? If so, what's the preferred mechanism (invoice-level discount vs. third-party financing)?

I've cc'd our procurement mailbox. Attached is the completed onboarding form and a sample invoice. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Sofia Reyes
Head of Vendor Ops
HelionTech
Attachments: Helion_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Sample_Invoice_001.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Reyes <s.reyes@heliontech.com>
Cc: HelionTech Procurement <procure@heliontech.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding form + invoice cutoff / early pay inquiry

Hi Sofia — welcome, and thanks for the form (received). Looping in Finance (David) and Procurement ops (Marissa) so we can align on the operational and commercial sides. A few quick notes to set expectations and next steps: 

- Invoice cutoff: Redwood recognizes invoices as received based on the invoice PDF delivery timestamp to invoices@redwood.com (we also accept invoices uploaded via the vendor portal). To hit the 15th cycle you want to be submitted by 23:59 PT on the 15th. We also route by PO number — missing PO# is the most common cause of delays.

- PO header mapping: I'll attach our internal PO header spec (PO_Header_Mapping_Spec.xlsx). Required fields: PO#, Redwood GL code (we map at remit), vendor remit name, vendor remit address, and invoice reference. Optional fields we accept: cost center, project tag. If you can map PO# and remit name to your invoice template we'll avoid manual routing.

- Net terms / early-pay: Redwood's default for new vendors is Net45. Finance can review early-pay pilots but typically requires a short attestation and a vendor discount structure (invoice-level discount is preferred — simple for AP to process). David — can you confirm what approval path / rate thresholds we need here?

Next steps I propose: 
1) Sofia to confirm you can include the PO# and remit details on the invoice PDF (we can test with the sample invoice).
2) Helion signs the vendor attestation (one-pager) for early-pay pilot if you want to move forward.
3) David, Marissa, and I will triage risk/approval and confirm whether we can do Net30 or run a Net15 discounted pilot.

If helpful, let's do a quick 20-min sync Thu or Fri — happy to coordinate times.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: PO_Header_Mapping_Spec.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Sofia Reyes <s.reyes@heliontech.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding form + invoice cutoff / early pay inquiry

Thanks for starting this thread, Vanessa. A couple internal clarifications and a proposed operational plan: 

- Finance view: For new suppliers we'll usually onboard Net45 by default. Net30 is considered for partners with an established spend cadence and standard tax/insurance docs. Net15 and early-pay discounts can be done as a pilot but must be documented (we use a one-page "Early Pay Discount Agreement" and route to FinOps for sign-off).

- Risk ops: I'll need a completed W-9 (or equivalent), and confirmation that Helion's invoices include the PO# in the filename and invoice body (this allows automated matching).

Proposed pilot flow (operational):
1) Helion submits three invoices in May/June with PO# correctly mapped.
2) Redwood AP processes invoices as Net45, but flags the three pilot invoices for accelerated payment if the discount path is approved.
3) If approved, AP will apply the invoice-level discount at payment time and record the discount in our payment ledger.

Can you upload the W-9 and the completed onboarding PDF to the Drive folder I shared (link below)? Also include the vendor contact for remittance questions. If Helion prefers, we can use our vendor portal to set up a recurring remit contact.

Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B1Helion/Onboarding (please upload the attestation there).

Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

Sofia — quick sync and next steps to get you live: 

1) Can you confirm you uploaded the signed W-9 and the completed onboarding PDF to the Drive folder? We need those to complete vendor record creation.
2) Please confirm that future invoice PDFs include the PO# in the filename (PO123456_Invoice_001.pdf) and in the invoice body. That will allow automatic routing to AP.
3) If you'd like the early-pay pilot, reply to this thread saying you accept a 2% invoice-level discount for Net15 and we'll route the pilot to Finance. If approved, we'll process the three pilot invoices on Net15 less 2%.

I can schedule a 20-min call on Monday 5/17 at 10:00 AM PT to walk through the PO header mapping and run a test invoice. Proposed agenda: quick W-9/checklist, sample invoice validation, sign-off on early-pay attestation. If that time doesn't work, send a couple options.

Looking forward — Vanessa
